SOLAR PANEL STORAGE
===================

1. Keep the front side of the solar panel facing up.

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/storage-step-1
   :alt: SolarSaga 40 Air front side facing up before folding.
   :width: 100%

2. Fold the solar panel along the creases from left to right as shown in the figure. Handle with care. Do not pull or apply excessive force to the solar panel.

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/storage-step-2
   :alt: First and second SolarSaga 40 Air folding movements from left to right.
   :width: 100%

3. After folding is complete, fasten the snap buttons to secure the solar panel.

.. image:: asset:web/js40c/eu/en/storage-step-3
   :alt: Folded SolarSaga 40 Air secured with its snap buttons.
   :width: 100%
